note: Lucny konik playground in Cierna Voda (Rekreapark by Javorova alej), product-owner request 2026-10-06: the open timber picnic shelter (four-sided shingle hip roof, round log posts, a stone block with the chimney at its right end) seen from the meadow in front, camera ~2.2 m, horizon y ~360 (flat fields, a tree belt, faint low hills), the front posts stand on y 655 (~130 px per metre). Perspective scale s(y) = (y - 360) / 655. The multi-coloured paving lies only under and around the shelter (front edge y ~780); below it the trampled meadow grass. Walkable: the paving in front of the posts, the sandy path out of the left edge, the gravel path out of the right edge (S07) and the trampled grass in front (S02 left, S04 right); not the grass at the far left with the balance beam and the standing stone (its foot y ~690), nor the meadow behind the stone block. The distribution tables stand under the roof right behind the front posts, the distancing tapes lie on the paving in front of the left table where people queue, Ela stands beside the stone block (the side wall) at the right end of the shelter. Since v6 (owner 2026-10-06 afternoon) a generic wooden grasshopper climbing figure (invented carpentry, not the real sculpture) stands on the meadow behind the slide, between the play tower and the front-left post, its rear behind the left table's bags; it is background only (no hotspot), the walk polygon stays in front of it.
